result.document_summary: A mid-document excerpt of San Diego Municipal Code Chapter 3, Article 5, Division 2 (a transient occupancy special tax for homelessness programs, street repair, and the Convention Center), covering budgets, reporting, bonds and definitions, with no residential rental rules.
result.notes: This part (75 of 364) contains only §§ 35.0204-35.0211 of a tax Division (use of additional transient occupancy tax revenues, budgets, audits, bond authorization, definitions). The source URL points to San Diego's anti-competitive automated rent price-fixing Division (§ 98.1103), but none of that text appears in this part. Mentions of affordable housing, rental vouchers and security-deposit subsidies appear only as funded homelessness-program activities, not as rules on rent, eviction, deposits, screening or pricing algorithms. No in-scope rules extracted.
